## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature.

- What problem does this solve?
- What are the key architectural or UI changes?

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI/UX refinement (visual improvement, animation polish)
- [ ] Security / Rule update (Firestore rules, authentication)
- [ ] Documentation update (README, diagrams, guidelines)

## Pre-Flight Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the repository style and architecture guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified that no em-dashes are present in rendered UI copy.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with zero errors.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds without build warnings or breaks.
- [ ] Mobile responsive layout tested on viewport width <= 390px.
